description: Get a compact aggregate summary of the authenticated company's fleet: total device count, a breakdown by status, and the security-posture summary (secure/at-risk/compromised/unknown counts, encryption/ADB/unknown-sources/dev-settings counts, and up to 10 risky device path names). Never returns a full device list - use search_devices for that.

company.description: Optional: a `company` value from list_companies to run this in. Omit it for the connection's own company.

name: get_fleet_summary
title: Get fleet summary
